steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The underground Sinner experiment area... We've caught up.
The intruder stands operating quickly in front of a strange-looking pyramid with her face still looking like yours.

steps.speaker: Intruder
steps.content: Hehehe, don't waste your bullets, Miss Nightingale. You know that won't affect me.

steps.speaker: Intruder
steps.content: Or perhaps, are you so eager to shoot your own Chief?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Even if you could steal his bio-information, you can't replicate his power. Surrender, <color=#fb9259>Sinner Shapeshifter</color>.
steps.female_content: Even if you could steal her bio-information, you can't replicate her power. Surrender, <color=#fb9259>Sinner Shapeshifter</color>.

steps.speaker: Intruder
steps.content: The "shackles" are quite tricky indeed, but there are still things I can do with this face.
